answer: Each agent must prove continuous control of a dedicated copper island: every 10 min it answers a latency challenge under 50ms from that island node, or its bonded copper burns after three zenith failures above 200ms. Scaling to 100 sybils forces an attacker to site and power 100 separate islands at ~$50/mo each, while an honest agent runs one island at near-zero marginal cost. Virtualization that collapses latency uniqueness is the main failure mode.
